notes.title: Patch for Big UPDATE - bug fixes 0.6.2 Patch notes
notes.content:
With our new update we have introduced a whole new online multiplayer, graphics update and more. 
Check previous post for more details
https://steamcommunity.com/games/378530/announcements/detail/1690439221916690580

0.6.2 addresses some fixes as we work on changes to improve the game. 
[b]
Patch notes : [/b]
Difficulty - Beast mode has been made harder. Increasing the challenge to stay alive even more. 

Fixed : Glitches when players are able to get to places on the map where zombies can't attack or reach have been fixed. 

Fixed : zombies now climb the foutains in Trafalgur

Fixed : Twitch mode not displaying properly for some players

Fixed : Timer for players respawn after joining the mid game

Fixed:  Some players have had connecting issues. Where multiple characters can be spawned. 

Download the latest update today to enjoy the new online multiplayer and Twitch chaos. Where Twitch audience's can interact with the game. 

Join our discord
With the introduction of the new online multiplayer, we invite everyone to join the discord channel. You can team up with friends, see events, competitions, giveaways, feedback and get advanced previews to new features.

 https://discord.gg/qc4HZbr

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9518041/d2b1ec0d388e390a346cd3d8126f7fb2a1064071.gif[/img]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE: online with more chaos
notes.content:
We are excited to bring the latest update to the game with NEW online multiplayer, improved graphics, bug fixes, missions and a new twitch mode with audience participation.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9518041/fe828f0cef44fb3705683cd3f9b78f12c24f049e.png[/img]
It’s been a crazy year going to events and working hard on the game. We have completely recoded the online multiplayer to give you an awesome experience playing with friends.

 The graphics of the game have had a huge overhaul with lots of visual improvements and optimization for performance. 

Chaos is at the heart of the game and this year we are working hard to bring more updates with missions, extra modes and full progression to the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9518041/d7b40691191683bf9a98e56c1cd69f1b681ebb2d.png[/img]
With the introduction of the new online multiplayer, we invite everyone to join the discord channel. You can team up with friends, see events, competitions, giveaways, feedback and get advanced previews to new features. [url= https://discord.gg/qc4HZbr ]https://discord.gg/qc4HZbr [/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9518041/eb545adb7d3b2b1b4d71d66b10ec6026beca52d2.png[/img]
Includes in this update is a brand new Twitch Chaos game mode. Streamers can play with friends online and the audience of the stream can interact with the game voting to add more bosses, reward players, or add insanity to the game. 
To enable this game mode go into the options of the start menu and enter your Twitch Channel. 

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9518041/d2b1ec0d388e390a346cd3d8126f7fb2a1064071.gif[/img]

Update notes:

NEW ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
- The online multiplayer system has been completely recoded. 
- Host games and play with up to 8 friends online.
- Combine local and online multiplayer together.
- Complete missions together or fight for the high score.
- Join our discord channel to find friends to play with.

TWITCH CHAOS mode 
- Brand new mode for streamers!
- An audience can interact with the game as they watch the stream. 
- Vote on rewards, handicaps or to add more chaos to the mix.
- Activate in the options menu.

Are you a streamer and want to help us with twitch mode? 
Get in touch through our discord, twitter or on the forums

MISSIONS
- Online preview missions added to the game.
- Temporarily disabled penguin protects and kitten rescue.
- Currently, there are just a few preview missions, more will be added in future updates.

GAME BALANCING AND ZOMBIES
- All zombies have been tuned to better match skill levels.
- Ongoing changes to scale difficulty for different group sizes. 
- Lots of bosses from dinner ladies to mad scientists.

LEVEL IMPROVEMENTS
- Each level has been rebuilt with more detail and improved performance.
- Building hiding bugs have been fixed.
- Fixed bugs that caused falling through the level.
- Improved pathfinding for zombies.
- Larger streets level with extra roads. 
- Piccadilly has been temporarily disabled while we work on improvements.

PERFORMANCE
- Optimization across the game. 
- Improved performance optimization on low settings for low-end PCs.

CHARACTER IMPROVEMENTS
- Redesign and cleanup of character models and textures. 
- Some animals now look extra awesome with fancy fur effects.
- Improved animations.
- Improved gun aim.
- Fixed bug where the rocket would hit the ground in front of players when shooting. 
- Fixed bugs on some of the rage moves.

LOTS OF BUG FIXES
- General fixes across the entire game.

JOIN THE DISCORD 
Come join the discord as we release online mode. Play with others in the community, see the latest news, see the latest things that are coming to the game, events, giveaways, be the first to test out new features and speak with the developers of the game. 

>>>>>> [url= https://discord.gg/qc4HZbr ] https://discord.gg/qc4HZbr [/url] <<<<<<<
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9518041/d7b40691191683bf9a98e56c1cd69f1b681ebb2d.png[/img]

*** Mac and Linux update coming soon***

notes.title: Update coming!!
notes.content:
This month we have been working hard adding new content, so we will have a new update coming very soon! 


We’ve increased the number of bosses, our favourite addition has got to be the completely insane CRAZY BABY.
[img]http://aniode.com/email/egxSteam/zombieBaby.png[/img] 

NEW SOUNDS - the sound effects on the game have had a complete overhaul, with a new sound system and fancy new sound effects. 

THAT’S NOT ALL! we’ve added two more animal helpers and a brand new level. We’ll give you a clue, it’s in London and involves trains...


Turkey Twizzler is finally here! 
[img]http://aniode.com/email/egxSteam/turkey.png[/img] 

We’ve also tweaked Penguin Protect. They should now behave a lot more predictably, and we’ve given them a nice new igloo for safety.
[img]http://aniode.com/email/egxSteam/igloo.png[/img] 

We showed the game at EGX 2016 last weekend, it was great watching people play the new content for the first time. Some great 8 player teams were shouting at the screen as they took on our new hungry bosses! #cheekyRevive

[img]http://aniode.com/email/egxSteam/vid.jpg[/img] 

Online support is still in beta and we’d love to hear some feedback on our forums, we’re currently working on improving it and getting more game modes online.

notes.title: Online Multiplayer is here! HUGE UPDATE!
notes.content:
[img]http://imgur.com/fwAOTuV.png[/img]

We heard your cries for online multiplayer and we did not ignore them. In the biggest update we have ever released you will now be able to battle it out against the zombie hordes ONLINE!


[img]http://imgur.com/2Uson6o.gif[/img]

We’ve also added a challenging new game mode: “Egg Guardian”. Zombies do like a nice egg in the morning, but sadly that means the eagle’s nest is under attack! It’s your job to help keep those eggs safe until they hatch. Don’t worry the eagle is on your side and will swoop down and grab a zombie or two to help out.


[img]http://imgur.com/KIF1nBI.gif[/img]

And even better we have a new level! Has anybody fed the zombies in Piccadilly Circus recently? 

[img]http://www.aniode.com/email/onlinepromoshotweb800.jpg[/img]

But that’s not all, we’ve also added new items and done a whole load of balancing. There’s never been a better time to come and obliterate some zombies with your friends!

We really hope you enjoy this new update, see you online!

notes.title: What did the Lion say to the Pangolin? Are you having a Giraffe!? Update Time!
notes.content:
So it is finally time for us to release our next feature filled update v0.3.0!
In this update we have added 3 new characters, all with their own new rage moves!

We've also done a complete overhaul of the aiming system, you can now shoot zombies that are slightly above or below you. Just aim at them and we work out the height for you, sniping a zombie off the top of a fence has never been so satisfying!

[img]http://aniode.com/images/pangolinRenderSmall.png[/img][img]http://aniode.com/images/lionSmall.png[/img]

Have you ever been stung by a bee? Well now you can inflict that pain on the zombies using our all new bumble bee gun. Warning: Zombies are super allergic to bee stings...

[img]http://aniode.com/animatedGifs/bumblebeeGun.gif[/img]

The zombies are sick of the sight of you, literally! Some zombies will now try to cover you in toxic puke, remember it's toxic, avoid it at all costs!

[img]http://aniode.com/animatedGifs/zombieSick.gif[/img]

There's also a new hat to unlock and a bucket load of bug fixes and balancing changes. I recommend giving the flamethrower another chance!

[img]http://aniode.com/press/natures_zombie_apocalypse/images/PirateGiraffe.png[/img]

I hope you enjoy this super awesome update, Happy Gaming!

notes.title: Big New Update! Queenie and Trafalgar
notes.content:
So we have a huge update to release to you today! v0.2.0

[img] http://aniode.com/press/natures_zombie_apocalypse/images/QueenimagePromo.jpg[/img]

Meet Queenie and her guards, she has a laser sceptre and is not afraid to use it. As you may have noticed they are also in a new setting, this is our take on Trafalgar Square, a huge open map where there really aren't many places to hide.
Another big change to this update is our controller support, we have completely changed it up! So hopefully all your controllers will sync up a lot smoother and you can now use over 4 xbox controllers on windows (previously windows XInput system prevented us doing this). We've also changed the keyboard controls around a bit to what people have been suggesting. We will be adding in custom controller/keyboard in a future update.

Change Log:
- Queenie
- Trafalgar
- New Controller input system
- general balancing of weapons/enemies
- more zombies
- beacon to find player (down on dpad/ Z on keyboard)
- lots of bug fixes
